items.name: Hudson Valley Open 2018
items.information: **Payment - Mandatory** After registering please visit the payment tab and send $22 to the PayPal account listed. If you do not do this then you will NOT be able to compete. Thank you. **Lunch Options:** Pizza slices will be available at the competition, $2 per slice. If you want pizza please comment how many slices you when you are registering. **If you do not preorder the pizza there is no guarantee you will get any!** Water bottles will also be available for purchase, but you don't have to preorder for water. Also snacks will be sold at the competition by our food and snacks supervisor, Evan Rich. **Raffle:** There will be a raffle with various signed cubes. The raffle tickets will be sold for $1 each. **Registration Fee:** There is an 80 competitor limit. Registration is online only, and is $22 per competitor. Spectators may enter for free.
